serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: So this is the place…
You: It’s all rubble. What happened here?
Bot: There was a fire here. Multiple points of origin. That would suggest that someone did it on purpose.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s not all. These lighter spots on the ground mean something was taken from here. Something heavy.
Bot: Outlets on the wall are also less charred. Something was plugged in during the fire.
Shanice: Server racks?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s possible.
Shanice: Even if this is the place where you were made, we still don’t know how you ended up in a ditch near Anon’s apartment.
You: Actually, I saw a military truck. She fell off from the cargo compartment.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Did you see the plate number? Were there any noticeable symbols on the car body?
You: Sorry, it was dark and I wasn’t paying attention.
Shanice: It’s ok. Don’t worry about it. It’s not like we were expecting anything useful from you anyway.
You: Thanks…{{wi}} I feel better now…
Shanice: So what do we know so far? 
Bot: This place was used as some sort of hidden lab, someone set it on fire and then everything was retrieved and packed in a military-like truck from which I fell off and ended up in a ditch.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There’s also someone who was observing that place that operates within 5 miles.
This is very disturbing. Someone was monitoring this place!
Maybe coming here was a bad idea…
If not for Priestbot, someone would know we were here.
Shanice: Let’s look around a little, maybe we will find something.
You: In these ruins? There is only rubble and ash…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s worth a shot. We can look around if we are already here.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Don’t tell me- Are you scared?
You: No I’m not!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: So give us a second. We will be done soon enough.
